facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. Applications for a specific program or university are made according to the respective announcement on the internet. Please refer to the relevant announcement for application requirements and application documents.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: There are separate application procedures for European and worldwide programs. The announcement and selection for worldwide programs occur before the selection for European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, applying for the European exchange under the Erasmus+ program is possible without restriction.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The announcements and selections for worldwide and European exchanges occur simultaneously. Announcements are published at the end of October with a submission deadline of February 1 of the following year.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
